choices.why: A low, slim track-arm two-seat sofa in warm beige linen is clean and minimal, and fits against the right wall without crowding the room.
A large 160x230 jute rug has a natural texture and warm neutral tone, and is big enough to sit under both the sofa and the coffee table.
A round wooden coffee table in warm tones, 110 cm wide, matches the brief and anchors the seating area on the rug.
A tall rice-paper floor lamp is the paper lantern the user asked for, and it takes up very little floor space in the corner by the sofa.
A rustic stoneware pot in cream and ochre is a ceramic pot with a handmade Japandi feel, large enough for a big plant beside the balcony glass.

answer.why: Everything is in warm beige, cream and light wood, with natural textures (jute, paper, stoneware) that sit well against the dark grey floor and white walls. The set is small and uncluttered, which keeps the room calm and minimal as the user asked.
